title: Incident Commander
description: Holds overall authority for the incident. Activates the Hospital Emergency Operations Plan, sets incident objectives, and is the final decision authority until relieved or the incident is closed.

title: Public Information Officer
description: Single point of contact for media and public information. Develops and releases approved public statements and coordinates with external public information officers (fire, law enforcement, public health).

title: Safety Officer
description: Monitors incident operations for hazards to patients, staff, and visitors. Has the authority to stop or modify any unsafe operation.

title: Liaison Officer
description: Primary point of contact for external responding agencies, other healthcare facilities, and government/public health officials.

title: Medical/Technical Specialist
description: Advises the Incident Commander on a specific technical area (e.g., infectious disease, hazmat, pediatric care, legal affairs, risk management, medical ethics). Specialty is noted per assignment.

title: Operations Section Chief
description: Directs execution of all tactical patient care and incident response activities defined in the Incident Action Plan.

title: Staging Manager
description: Manages the staging area for arriving personnel, vehicles, equipment, and supplies before they are assigned to the incident.

title: Personnel Staging Team Leader
description: Checks in and stages arriving personnel (mutual aid staff, volunteers, credentialed providers) until assigned.

title: Vehicle Staging Team Leader
description: Stages arriving vehicles (ambulances, transport vehicles) in a designated area pending assignment.

title: Equipment/Supply Staging Team Leader
description: Stages incoming equipment and supplies until distributed to the branch that requested them.

title: Medication Staging Team Leader
description: Stages incoming pharmaceuticals and medical countermeasures pending distribution to treatment areas.

title: Medical Care Branch Director
description: Directs all patient care operations across inpatient, outpatient, casualty care, behavioral health, and clinical support functions.

title: Inpatient Unit Leader
description: Coordinates continuity of care for currently admitted patients, including evacuation or shelter-in-place decisions for inpatient units.

title: Outpatient Unit Leader
description: Coordinates care and flow for ambulatory/outpatient patients during the incident, including clinic and same-day service areas.

title: Casualty Care Unit Leader
description: Directs triage, treatment, and tracking of incoming casualties in a multi-casualty or mass-casualty incident.

title: Behavioral Health Unit Leader
description: Coordinates behavioral health and crisis counseling support for patients, families, and staff during and after the incident.

title: Clinical Support Unit Leader
description: Coordinates clinical support services (lab, pharmacy, imaging, respiratory therapy) needed to sustain patient care operations.

title: Patient Registration Unit Leader
description: Maintains registration and tracking records for all patients presenting to or processed by the facility during the incident.

title: Infrastructure Branch Director
description: Directs management of the facility's physical systems and utilities during the incident: power, water, HVAC, structural integrity, and medical gases.

title: Power/Lighting Unit Leader
description: Manages facility power and lighting systems, including backup generator operation, during the incident.

title: Water/Sewer Unit Leader
description: Manages facility water supply and sewer/wastewater systems during the incident.

title: HVAC Unit Leader
description: Manages heating, ventilation, and air conditioning systems, including isolation/negative-pressure controls during the incident.

title: Building/Grounds Unit Leader
description: Assesses and manages structural and grounds damage, and coordinates repairs during the incident.

title: Medical Gases Unit Leader
description: Manages medical gas systems (oxygen, medical air, vacuum) during the incident.

title: Security Branch Director
description: Directs facility security operations during the incident: access control, crowd/traffic control, and law enforcement coordination.

title: Access Control Unit Leader
description: Controls facility entry/exit points and restricts access to designated areas during the incident.

title: Crowd Control Unit Leader
description: Manages family, visitor, and media crowds at facility entrances and perimeter during the incident.

title: Traffic Control Unit Leader
description: Manages vehicle traffic flow around the facility, including ambulance and emergency vehicle access.

title: Search Unit Leader
description: Coordinates facility searches for hazards, suspicious items, or missing/wandering patients in coordination with law enforcement.

title: Law Enforcement Interface Unit Leader
description: Serves as the on-site point of contact for arriving law enforcement units.

title: HazMat Branch Director
description: Directs response to hazardous material exposure, contamination, or spill events affecting the facility.

title: Detection & Monitoring Unit Leader
description: Monitors for hazardous material presence and spread using available detection equipment.

title: Spill Response Unit Leader
description: Directs containment and cleanup of a hazardous material spill within the facility.

title: Victim Decontamination Unit Leader
description: Directs decontamination of contaminated patients before they enter clinical treatment areas.

title: Facility/Equipment Decontamination Unit Leader
description: Directs decontamination of affected facility areas and equipment.

title: Business Continuity Branch Director
description: Directs efforts to maintain or restore critical business and clinical operations (records, IT, billing) during the incident.

title: IT Systems and Applications Unit Leader
description: Maintains or restores IT systems and clinical applications (EHR, order entry) needed to sustain operations.

title: Services Continuity Unit Leader
description: Maintains continuity of essential support services (dietary, environmental services, materials management) during the incident.

title: Records Management Unit Leader
description: Protects and manages critical facility and patient records during the incident.

title: Patient Family Assistance Branch Director
description: Oversees patient and family support operations during the incident, including reunification and social services.

title: Social Services Unit Leader
description: Coordinates social work and support services for affected patients and families.

title: Family Reunification Unit Leader
description: Executes patient-family reunification: holding area, identity verification, and release process.

title: Planning Section Chief
description: Collects and evaluates incident information, tracks resource status, and develops the Incident Action Plan.

title: Resources Unit Leader
description: Tracks the status and availability of personnel and equipment committed to the incident.

title: Personnel Tracking Manager
description: Tracks the status and location of all personnel committed to the incident.

title: Materiel Tracking Manager
description: Tracks the status and location of equipment and supplies committed to the incident.

title: Situation Unit Leader
description: Maintains the real-time incident status board and overall situational picture.

title: Patient Tracking Manager
description: Tracks the real-time location, status, and disposition of every patient involved in the incident.

title: Bed Tracking Manager
description: Tracks real-time bed availability and capacity across the facility during the incident.

title: Documentation Unit Leader
description: Maintains the incident log and archives records for the After Action Review.

title: Demobilization Unit Leader
description: Plans and coordinates the safe, orderly release of resources and staff as the incident winds down.

title: Logistics Section Chief
description: Provides the facilities, equipment, and support resources needed to sustain the incident response.

title: Service Branch Director
description: Directs communications, IT equipment, and staff food/water services supporting the response.

title: Communications Unit Leader
description: Operates radios and internal communications equipment during the incident.

title: IT/IS Equipment Unit Leader
description: Provides and maintains IT equipment needed to support the incident response.

title: Food Services Unit Leader
description: Coordinates food and water for staff, patients, and responders during an extended incident.

title: Support Branch Director
description: Directs supply, transportation, employee health, and credentialing support for the incident response.

title: Employee Health & Well-Being Unit Leader
description: Monitors staff wellbeing and manages rest/rotation during an extended incident.

title: Supply Unit Leader
description: Manages incident-related medical and non-medical supplies.

title: Transportation Unit Leader
description: Coordinates vehicles and transport needed for patient movement, evacuation, or resource delivery.

title: Labor Pool & Credentialing Unit Leader
description: Verifies credentials of arriving volunteer or mutual-aid clinical staff before assignment.

title: Employee Family Care Unit Leader
description: Supports staff members whose own families are affected by the incident.

title: Finance/Administration Section Chief
description: Tracks incident-related costs and documentation required for insurance, reimbursement, or regulatory claims.

title: Time Unit Leader
description: Records staff hours worked during the incident for payroll and reimbursement documentation.

title: Procurement Unit Leader
description: Handles emergency purchasing and vendor contracts during the incident.

title: Compensation/Claims Unit Leader
description: Documents injury, damage, or liability claims arising from the incident.

title: Cost Unit Leader
description: Tracks total incident costs for budgeting, grant, and reimbursement purposes.
